name: Pacific Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Pacific Beach?
answer_short: A street-legal LSV can drive on Pacific Beach streets posted 35 mph or less, including Garnet Ave and Mission Blvd, under CVC 21260. A plain golf cart is limited to streets posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district (CVC 21716). Posted signs win.

lsv.notes: May cross faster roads at intersections

rules.rule: Only roads posted 35 mph or less
Roads posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on Grand Ave in Pacific Beach?
faq.a: Yes. Grand Ave from Mission Blvd to Mission Bay Dr is posted 35 mph, so LSVs may use it.
